capability.name: npm and PyPI provenance check: built where it says, logged on Sigstore
capability.description: Verifies the Sigstore attestations of an npm or PyPI release itself, from pinned keys: the Fulcio certificate chain (code signing, valid when logged), the DSSE signature over the in-toto statement, the statement's subject against the npm tarball's sha512 or the PyPI file's sha256, the Rekor entry's signed timestamp, its RFC 9162 inclusion proof under a checkpoint signed by Rekor, and that the logged entry holds this signature and certificate. Returns where it was built (repository, commit, ref, workflow, trigger, run URL) from the certificate, npm's registry signatures and publish attestation, PyPI's trusted publisher against the certificate, and your expected repository, workflow or ref. Verdict verified, expectation_mismatch, no_provenance or invalid. Not checked: embedded SCTs, revocation.

file.description: PyPI only: one file of the release

workflow.description: expected workflow path or file name

note: was this release built from the repository it claims, and is it on Sigstore's log
